name: com.linkonda/mcp
description: Create and manage Linkonda short links and QR codes, with no per-visitor tracking.

environmentVariables.name: LINKONDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Linkonda API key (paid plans). Optional — without it the server still shortens URLs anonymously, but links expire and account tools are unavailable.

environmentVariables.name: LINKONDA_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API host. Defaults to https://api.linkonda.com.
